newsitem.title: USA: St Joe offers $102/shr for Fla East.
newsitem.headline: St Joe offers $102/shr for Fla East.

text.p: St. Joe Corp said Monday it made a proposal to Florida East Coast Industries under which St. Joe and Florida East Coast would merge and all shares of Florida East Coast that St Joe doesn't own would be exchanged for cash at $102 per share.
St. Joe said there are about 9.1 million shares of Florida East Coast common outstanding, of which about 4.9 million, or 54 percent, are owned by St. Joe.
On May 2, the closing price on the New York Stock Exchange of Florida East Coast common stock was $88-3/4 a share and of St. Joe was $73-1/4 per share.
The merger would be subject to regulatory approvals and by shareholders of Florida East Coast, as well as other customary terms, St. Joe said.
The proposal is also subject to negotiation of a merger agreement, St. Joe said.
